items.headline: 49ers WR Mike Evans a game-time decision with rib injury
items.description: Niners wide receiver Mike Evans is questionable for Sunday, but he said he will give "my best" to play against the Broncos as he deals with a rib injury.

items.headline: 49ers owner Jed York suspended six games, fined $500K by NFL
items.description: 49ers owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy stemming from his August arrest after he tried to engage in prostitution in Ohio.
